name: Guilt
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 1, cleric/oracle 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, AF (small mirror, 10gp)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one living creature of nongood alignment
Duration 1d4 rounds
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

A nongood creature is forced to think about some evil deed it performed, denying it any actions except to defend itself.
